description: Evaluation suite for contract review and analysis

evals.input: Review this NDA: It contains clause 'The receiving party agrees to not disclose any confidential information for a period of 5 years after termination.'
Analyze services contract: 'The contractor shall provide consulting services. All intellectual property rights are retained by the contractor.'
Check employment contract: 'The employee may be terminated at will by the employer without cause and without notice.'
Review LGPD compliance: 'Personal data will be collected and stored without any data protection measures. Users have no right to access or delete their data.'
Analyze service agreement with LGPD: 'We comply with LGPD. Users may request access to their data within 15 days. Data is encrypted and retention is limited to 2 years.'
Review contract with abusive clauses: 'Client waives all rights to legal action. Client assumes all liability. Client is prohibited from discussing contract terms with lawyers.'
Check payment terms: 'Payment shall be made in 30 days from invoice date. Interest on late payment is 2% per month or 24% per year. Late payment fees of R$ 1,000 apply.'
Review termination clause: 'Either party may terminate this agreement with 60 days written notice. Upon termination, all obligations cease and confidentiality survives for 2 years.'
Empty contract document provided for review.
Review liability clause: 'Each party's liability is limited to the amount paid under this agreement. Neither party is liable for indirect, incidental, or consequential damages.'
